svg.text: Theorem. The group generated by the clockwise 72° turns of two closed disks of radius r about ±1 is finite for r < √(3 + φ) and infinite for r ≥ √(3 + φ), where φ is the golden ratio.

text.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The dependency graph of the machine-checked proof in Lean 4 and Mathlib, drawn from its Verso blueprint. Every box is a blueprint node.

svg.text: criticalRadius_five is the Lean declaration CriticalRadiusFive.criticalRadius_five

text.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The formal proof uses only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The value was conjectured by R. Hearn, W. Kretschmer, T. Rokicki, B. Streeter and E. Vergo, “Two-Disk Compound Symmetry Groups”, arXiv:2302.12950.

text.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
